description:
We are looking for experienced front-end UI Engineers for mobile iOS platform. You will help us launch new, state-of-the-art wearable devices and platforms, including augmented reality, fitness coaching, and other comprehensive wearable technologies. As Senior UX/UI Mobile Developer you will work directly with our product, design and test teams to develop a platform for creating the most innovative wearable products. You will be working with enthusiastic and experienced peers in an environment that facilitates delivering industry-leading solutions with both creative-edge and high quality. 
 

 What You Will Be Doing  
 Use Swift to developing native iOS applications with optimal performance and battery usage 
 Tying the application to the back-end services provided by Intel's new wearable platform 
 Contributing to platform UI/UX specifications 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. 
 Validating your code for robustness, including testing edge cases, usability, and general - reliability. 
 Collaborating with remote global teams, including device, cloud, test, etc. to innovate new technologies with maximum development efficiency. 
 

  

 Strong iOS applications development skills, fluency in Swift (you can program now!) 
 Extensive experience working with iOS UI design frameworks, including NS framework, UI Kit 
 Low-level knowledge of iOS functioning including background execution 
 Working knowledge of relational databases and SQLite/Core Data 
 Experience developing large-scale native mobile apps on Apple iOS 
 Experience optimizing for performance, compact code and low battery usage 
 Strong knowledge of Apple ecosystem and platform specific details 
 Solid understanding of the full mobile development life cycle 
 Essential Object Oriented analysis and design skills, including concurrency, multi-threading, defensive programming 
 Experience publishing at least one iPhone and/or iPad application on the App Store (you know what it takes) 
 Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Architecture, or related major, or equivalent experience 
 

 Additional Preferred Qualifications  
 You have a Github account showcasing your creative skills and past projects. 
 Strong portfolio with examples of well thought design for mobile applications 
 

 Nice to Have — Aspirational Skills  
 Experience with Bluetooth LE protocol 
 Knowledge of Android platform and Android SDK 
 Ability to understand and parse XML, JSON and serialized data 
 Experience with Amazon Web Services and Cloud Services 
 Master’s Degree or another advanced degree is preferred
 
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES.
